Performers
The Modena Chamber Orchestra (ensemble, as credited in the source summary) Disputed: sources disagree

The Commons title, summary and source link credit the Modena Chamber Orchestra; its embedded Author metadata instead says Orpheus Chamber Orchestra. No soloist or conductor is established, and the conflicting tag is not treated as proof of Orpheus’s participation.

  • The Modena Chamber Orchestra (Commons title and summary attribution)
  • Orpheus Chamber Orchestra (embedded Author tag only)
[1]
Work version
Unknown Unknown

Commons identifies the complete first movement but no performing edition. No cut or omission is asserted from the duration alone; the automatic full-movement correspondence has median cosine confidence 0.950.

[1]
Recorded
Unknown Unknown

The summary’s ≤ 2020-05-16 is an availability bound, not an identified session. Embedded digitizing metadata says 15 May 2020 and upload occurred on 26 December 2022; neither establishes when the musicians recorded.

[1]
Place
Unknown Unknown

No recording venue or city is identified. The ensemble’s name is not venue evidence.

[1]
Label
Unknown Unknown

Musopen is the digital source; no original carrier label is identified.

Unknown Unknown

No release catalogue number is supplied.

Matrix, take, sides
Unknown Unknown

No original matrix, take or side identification is established.

Transfer
Toast for Teddy uploaded the Musopen-derived file to Wikimedia Commons Documented

The uploader is documented; original recording and mastering engineers are not.

[1]
Transfer date
Unknown Unknown

No verified mastering or transfer date. The embedded digitizing timestamp and Commons upload date are retained in the session note, not promoted to session evidence.

[1]
Processing
Pitch adjusted 20 cents down from the original recording Documented

The Commons description states this processing explicitly. The algorithm, original pitch standard and whether duration changed are unspecified. Commons supplies an MP3 derivative of the Ogg Vorbis file; Contrapunctus adds no pitch or speed processing to playback.

[1]
Composition rights
Vivaldi’s underlying composition is public domain Inferred, not documented

The eighteenth-century composition is distinct from this modern sound recording and from any unidentified performing edition.

[1] [3]
Recording rights
Commons PDMark-owner declaration for the Musopen-sourced sound recording Documented

Accepted under the explicit recording-release rule: Commons says the copyright holder made the file available under Public Domain Mark 1.0. This reports the published declaration, not independently verified ownership. The conflicting ensemble tag is retained above; no pre-1963 or historic-recording term calculation is used.

[1]

Antonio Vivaldi, Spring, RV 269, I. Allegro. The Modena Chamber Orchestra as credited by Commons/Musopen; conflicting embedded Orpheus attribution unresolved. Session date unknown. Musopen, via Wikimedia Commons uploader Toast for Teddy; source pitch lowered 20 cents. Commons PDMark-owner declaration. Rights statement

  1. Wikimedia Commons — The Modena Chamber Orchestra, Vivaldi’s Spring, I. Allegro — Summary, Licensing, file history and embedded Metadata read directly. Summary attribution Modena conflicts with Author tag Orpheus; pitch adjustment is explicit.. Accessed 2026-10-17.
  2. Musopen — The Four Seasons, Op. 8 — Upstream source linked by Commons. Direct access returned HTTP 403; not treated as independent confirmation of the Commons attribution or release statement.. Accessed 2026-10-17.
  3. José Rodríguez Alvira — Vivaldi, La Primavera, I. Allegro — Score-based movement outline: ritornellos, birds, running water, storm and return to E major. Used as commentary only; no audio is taken from this page.. Accessed 2026-10-17.
